exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix log-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: log-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create 'Long recovery trail'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt
exec card --actor geordi log add log-1 'First observation.'
exec card --actor geordi log add log-1 'Second observation.'
exec card --actor geordi log add log-1 'Third observation.'
exec card --actor geordi log add log-1 'Fourth observation.'

exec card log list log-1 --limit 2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/newest-two.txt
exec card --json log list log-1 --oldest-first --limit 2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/oldest-two.jsonl

! exec card log list log-1 --reverse
stderr 'unknown flag --reverse'

exec card log list --help
stdout 'Newest entries are listed first'
stdout '--oldest-first'
stdout 'Maximum entries after ordering'

log-1
